blocks.text: You can add resources for which you define and set up policy rules. The admins can perform the following operations:

blocks.item: Adding a Removable Storage Resource
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint Data Scan > Resources > Removable Storage.
Click Add.
The New Removable Storage Resource drawer appears.
In the New Removable Storage Resource drawer:
Name: Enter a name for the device.
Description: Enter a description for the device.
Add Criteria: Select one or all of the following options:
Vendor ID: Enter the vendor ID assigned to the removable storage resource.
Product ID: Enter the product ID of the removable storage resource.
Serial Number: Enter the removable storage resource's serial number.
See Image.
Click Save and activate the change.
Editing a Removable Storage Resource
From the navigation menu, go to Data Security > Endpoint DLP > Endpoint Data Scan > Resources > Removable Storage.
Locate the portable device resource in the list, then click the Edit icon.
The Edit Removable Storage Resource drawer appears.
In the Edit Removable Storage Resource drawer, edit the settings for the selected resource as required.
See Image.
Click Save and activate the change.
You can delete any resource by selecting the resource from the list and clicking the Delete icon.
